page_title: LearnlyAI — AI Study App for Lectures, Notes & Past Papers

sources.entry: Learnly AI - AI-powered academic assistant for students with note-taking, essay writing, and presentation generation.

summary.name: LearnlyAI
summary.one_liner: LearnlyAI is an AI study app for high school and university students that records and translates lectures, imports Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard or Brightspace courses, and offers 20,000+ past papers with mark schemes.
use_cases: Revising for A-Level, GCSE, IGCSE, IB or AP exams
Practising with past papers and mark schemes
Importing LMS courses and deadlines into one place
summary.what_it_does: LearnlyAI organises courses, files and tasks by course and lets users ask an AI assistant questions about their own course materials. It records lectures with a live transcript that is translated as the lecturer speaks, and can turn recordings into notes, key points and flashcards afterwards. A browser extension imports courses, files, assignments and deadlines from Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard or Brightspace, as a manual run rather than live sync. It also provides 20,000+ free past papers and mark schemes from CIE, Edexcel, AQA, OCR and others, plus revision notes by syllabus, and can generate flashcards and exam-style questions from uploaded notes.
notable: Live lecture transcription with translation while recording
Browser extension imports Canvas, Moodle, Blackboard and Brightspace courses
20,000+ free past papers and mark schemes across major exam boards
Apple Pencil annotation of lecture PDFs in the iPad app
caveats: Canvas/LMS import is manual, not a live sync; must be re-run for updates
Handwriting annotations on iPad are saved on that device only and not synced
Pro plan unlocks more AI usage and full feature set; free plan has a small monthly AI allowance
